data.title: Termination of employment during probation period
data.summary: Exempel Logistik Hafenrand GmbH terminates Leon Musterkamp's employment during the probationary period, giving two weeks' notice effective 3 December 2026. The letter was handed over in person on 19 November 2026 at 9:40, and any lawsuit challenging the dismissal must be filed with the labour court within the deadline shown.
data.explanation: Your employer has ended your job while you were still in the probation period, with the dismissal taking effect on 3 December 2026. If you think the dismissal is unlawful, you can only challenge it by filing a lawsuit (Kündigungsschutzklage) with the labour court; the app will show you the exact deadline for this. You should also register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit right away to avoid problems with unemployment benefits, and return your work clothes and transponder on your last day. Consider getting advice from a lawyer or the Betriebsrat if you want to contest the dismissal.
